高朋滿座#155粵
programme.desc: 亨的父親突然來訪，說出近日受索羅斯「狙擊」。亨以為父親將破產，朋發現亨對父親是否破產不在意，亨信憑自己「有學識、人脈廣及有身材」的優點，可令家族重拾昔日光輝。可是，亨目空一切的態度，令他處處碰壁而回。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#30粵普PG
programme.desc: 周寅之被刀琴抓了回來，呂顯提將其殺掉為芳吟報仇。張遮給了謝危聖上賜的令牌，拿著它就可以出入皇城調動燕家軍，薛遠卻帶人趕了過來，謝危雖然是他的親兒薛定非，但他沒有一絲一毫情分，父子二人對峙著…

programme.title: 食平3D粵
programme.desc: 一尾烏頭渾身是寶，「酸菜魚尾湯」方便易熬；新式烏頭凍食，配上自製泰式醬令六號大讚。「雞鬆松子生菜包 」重點在雞鬆煮法，肥媽還出動招牌武器助陣。將韓式辣醬加入豆瓣醬，配合安格斯牛肉烹調出「辣醬炒肥牛」。

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG 「私人財富」─ 財富+粵
programme.desc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

programme.title: 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 《用心‧家的中秋味道》由星級藝員傅嘉莉、關嘉敏、關楓馨、姚焯菲、黃奕斌、謝雪心參與演出。節目藉着一家四姐妹跟月餅相關的工作、學習與生活日常，帶出連鎖餅店用心製作、研發不同口味、款式的月餅，務求讓顧客能夠透過這種中秋慶節食品，感受家的味道。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 男、女均有機會感染人類乳頭瘤病毒(HPV)，縱是安全性行為，親密接觸過程中仍可能傳播病毒？HPV病毒當中，部份屬高危型如16及18型，跟子宮頸癌密切相關。婦產科醫生指HPV病毒可被免疫系統自行清除，但持續感染就可能演變成癌症，並細說如何診治。「跟大廚去搵食」，葉世昌師傅登場帶主持品嚐融合傳統與新派特色的泰北菜。菜式以酸辣為主，在炎炎夏日享用，更覺開胃。「睇餸食飯」，三姐奉上「腐乳醬雜菇蝦陳村粉」。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵
programme.desc: 中山蘆兜糉是非物質文化遺產，煒哥與曉華學用蘆兜葉包糉，見識傳統石窯煮法。另一老店主打砂鍋煎焗魚頭、叉燒餐包、家鄉炸香蕉，吃出懷舊滋味。零酒精醉龍咖啡竟散發陣陣酒香？咖啡店融合非遺文化，還設書房共享喜「閱」。置身豪裝酒家享用新派中山菜，果木烤鵝、木薑子蒸魚頭、巨型流沙菠蘿包，驚喜不斷！轉往古樸庭園歎家宴，用茶杯喝陳皮水鴨湯夠特色；私房炒肉蟹鮮甜香脆，楓馨竟連殼食……宵夜來個冬瓜盅粥底火鍋，才算滿足！

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG 「私人財富」─ 財富+粵
programme.desc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

programme.title: 東坡家事#16粵PG
programme.desc: 東坡失蹤，閏之越獄，皇上要少游徹查。太君逼閏之與韓元結婚，更要脅殺死東坡。韓元勸閏之假意答應，待洞房當晚逃走。素素將鎖匙交給東坡，東坡逃至花園被包圍；閏之逃至花園，發現太君在面前；這時大批官兵湧至……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 臨近寒假結束，小丸子跟同學在神社玩耍，卻被提醒忘了做新年寫大字功課。小丸子回家寫大字，多次寫錯令姐姐抱腹大笑，參考爺爺寫的大字亦不得要領。另一邊廂，花輪則讓家裡的員工代他寫大字。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這回「廠長話」遊戲，零食小兵表現出色，一直未有成員犯錯。芭菲精靈於是要大家拍掌自我嘉許，怎料竟是「陷阱」！遊戲隨即加速進行，大大考驗眾人的瞬間反應能力。在神奇地壺關卡，有「迷糊」的曲奇小兵推送地壺竟未瞄準目標；薯片兵團不但「超額」完成任務，而且使出撞擊地壺的高超技巧。挑戰「溶化之橋」時，一名曲奇女兵僅以單手拿着雪糕筒前行，表現輕鬆。薯片兵團則挑戰高難度，某隊員機智挽救雪糕避免掉落，獲芭菲精靈讚賞。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 萬聖節，小孩子們到處去向人要糖果。細菌人趁機搶奪小孩子們收到的糖果。細菌人偷聽到果Jam叔叔他們正準備前往毬栗山，於是搶先一步前往，並搶奪栗子，金，飩三兄妹收集了的栗子。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 近年流行大灣區醫療旅遊，即結合北上就醫 旅遊的模式，不少港人會在北上接受體檢、驗眼、洗牙、醫美、中醫或專科治療後，同時兼顧休閒購物。大灣區亦有不少港式醫療機構進駐，優勢是消除港人跨境就醫的文化與制度落差，同時保留內地成本優勢。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵
programme.desc: 某食肆的食物處理區域竟出現狗隻，市民更目睹員工觸摸狗隻，此舉引發食安疑慮。攝製隊進一步調查，發現該食肆並非狗隻友善餐廳。跟進報道男事主與水療女技師的金錢糾紛，女技師聲稱受從小認識的補習老師操控賣淫及PUA洗腦。攝製隊成功聯絡涉事補習老師，她否認指控，更指女技師有精神問題兼被包養前科。至於女技師控訴與老師一同買樓，但樓契上只有後者名字，老師又有何回應？不少人受關節痛困擾，節目帶來有助舒緩情況的資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2865粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵PG
programme.desc: 樹根欲將製作月餅的手藝傳授尚善等人，卻遇不少阻滯。其後，尚善等終於齊人，打算跟樹根學藝，卻發現他不在家中，而樹根近來亦常被敢威找去商議事情。眾人本以為出埠前還有充裕時間跟樹根學藝，但發現只有當天能齊人，遂聯絡樹根並得知他與敢威在一起。潮偉察覺不妥，與眾人前往敢威住所查看，詎料……敢威留眾人在其住所練習造月餅，其霸道的性格卻令眾人感難受。最終，眾人忍無可忍離去，只有樹根明瞭敢威心事，留下好言相勸……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#2粵PG
programme.desc: 準備匯報的幸如憶起預知夢中繼威、雪文推卸責任，讓她背上黑鍋之事。幸如利用夢中經歷，揭發繼威和雪文抄襲外地廣告，對手葉家謙的團隊因而接下廣告工作。幸如為被困廁所的葉熙妍解窘，二人因此成為朋友。此外，幸如亦決心要讓繼威和雪文接收她夢裡的不幸。熙妍為上位而勾引家謙的謠言在公司網路上引起熱議，幸如更被指為散播傳聞的幕後黑手。幸如從譚婉蘭口中得知始作俑者為雪文，於是聯同熙妍、婉蘭當眾揭破雪文真面目……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 中風於本港有年輕化趨勢，這集個案患者年僅41歲。幸而她因及時把握急救黃金期，住院治療只一星期即可出院。腦神經科梁慧康教授演示「談笑用兵」的中風急救要訣，並介紹一站式緊急中風診治模式，有助大幅縮減搶救時間。教授提醒若出現身體單側無力、突然喪失視力等都可能是中風先兆。中風主要分為出血性中風「爆血管」，與缺血性中風「塞血管」，治療方案如何？近年亦倡導中西醫協作治療中風，調查員外訪中醫醫院教授，垂詢概況。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#7粵普
programme.desc: 蜜語升任行政樓層主管後，發生住客使用酒店毛巾致過敏事件，蜜語處理時的情況被放到網上，酒店面臨重大公關危機，董事長便讓紀封去整頓酒店。記者會上，紀封突然被拉上台負責回應傳媒，始作俑者凱鑫更想找蜜語頂罪…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
再創世紀#15粵PG
programme.desc: 啟堂甦醒卻未能說話，天生鬆一口氣，決定盡快吞併傲堂。敬賢的小說暢銷而名聲大噪，學禮出資支持兒子的出版社，敬賢堅拒。巴西一方撤資，天生建議配股解決公司危機，高哲故意表示同意，欲令定垚有所防範。經松蔭提點後，定垚提議出售娛樂城代替。程凱設立工作室後未有按時報告工作進度，又草率聘請遊戲高手喬永廉，澤雨不滿。財經記者曾依寧欲入股出版社，敬賢只聘請她為財經顧問。定垚得知娛樂城買家是高哲好友，決定選擇配股。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 某食肆的食物處理區域竟出現狗隻，市民更目睹員工觸摸狗隻，此舉引發食安疑慮。攝製隊進一步調查，發現該食肆並非狗隻友善餐廳。跟進報道男事主與水療女技師的金錢糾紛，女技師聲稱受從小認識的補習老師操控賣淫及PUA洗腦。攝製隊成功聯絡涉事補習老師，她否認指控，更指女技師有精神問題兼被包養前科。至於女技師控訴與老師一同買樓，但樓契上只有後者名字，老師又有何回應？不少人受關節痛困擾，節目帶來有助舒緩情況的資訊。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 男、女均有機會感染人類乳頭瘤病毒(HPV)，縱是安全性行為，親密接觸過程中仍可能傳播病毒？HPV病毒當中，部份屬高危型如16及18型，跟子宮頸癌密切相關。婦產科醫生指HPV病毒可被免疫系統自行清除，但持續感染就可能演變成癌症，並細說如何診治。「跟大廚去搵食」，葉世昌師傅登場帶主持品嚐融合傳統與新派特色的泰北菜。菜式以酸辣為主，在炎炎夏日享用，更覺開胃。「睇餸食飯」，三姐奉上「腐乳醬雜菇蝦陳村粉」。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵
programme.desc: 中山蘆兜糉是非物質文化遺產，煒哥與曉華學用蘆兜葉包糉，見識傳統石窯煮法。另一老店主打砂鍋煎焗魚頭、叉燒餐包、家鄉炸香蕉，吃出懷舊滋味。零酒精醉龍咖啡竟散發陣陣酒香？咖啡店融合非遺文化，還設書房共享喜「閱」。置身豪裝酒家享用新派中山菜，果木烤鵝、木薑子蒸魚頭、巨型流沙菠蘿包，驚喜不斷！轉往古樸庭園歎家宴，用茶杯喝陳皮水鴨湯夠特色；私房炒肉蟹鮮甜香脆，楓馨竟連殼食……宵夜來個冬瓜盅粥底火鍋，才算滿足！

programme.title: 東坡家事#17粵
programme.desc: 淑眉在街上遇到父母，藉口帶他們到客棧暫住。大妹因見紅擔心胎兒不保，大夫卻指她非小產而是信期，她與季常不知怎告訴月娥。史密跟蘇轍外出後，按樹葉上的小洞畫出地形。蘇轍開集思會被捉拿。東坡與琴操一見如故……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#155粵
programme.desc: 亨的父親突然來訪，說出近日受索羅斯「狙擊」。亨以為父親將破產，朋發現亨對父親是否破產不在意，亨信憑自己「有學識、人脈廣及有身材」的優點，可令家族重拾昔日光輝。可是，亨目空一切的態度，令他處處碰壁而回。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#30粵普PG
programme.desc: 周寅之被刀琴抓了回來，呂顯提將其殺掉為芳吟報仇。張遮給了謝危聖上賜的令牌，拿著它就可以出入皇城調動燕家軍，薛遠卻帶人趕了過來，謝危雖然是他的親兒薛定非，但他沒有一絲一毫情分，父子二人對峙著…

programme.title: 我係小廚神3粵
programme.desc: 小廚神冠軍爭奪戰，兩強連同助廚需煮出前菜、主菜、甜品，事前準備工夫做到足。他們手上還有三張指令牌，隨時召喚支援或要求對手助廚暫停工作。Nicole與Fergus這方意外頻生，她怎樣見招拆招？Timothy不停被激動的Cyrus「投訴」，所為何事？過程中小廚神盡顯真性情，還預先感受「職場陰暗」。兩小時後，法國童話故事主題美食與東南亞套餐上桌，爭取評判手上的金星章，冠軍誰屬，就看星級評判陳展鵬的一票！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#156粵
programme.desc: 慈姑突向慶等挑戰乒乓球，可是慶竟發現球拍被人塗花，回藥房問罪。喜直認不諱，指為懲罰他「不務正業」。慶看到「一蚊雞代客整蠱」服務網站，竟訂了整套服務給喜。翌日慶發現喜遇上連場怪事，全應驗了「整蠱服務」。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 大漠上，江南七怪苦尋六年，終通過匕首找到郭靖，並收其為徒。郭靖資質愚鈍，經馬鈺傳授內功心法後，武功突飛猛進。郭靖獨自赴比武之約，巧遇乞丐裝扮的黃蓉。穆家父女比武招親，完顏康佔了便宜卻拒絕與穆念慈成親…

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 韓風吹襲下，肥媽開始鑽研韓國料理港式煮法。「韓式炒蓮藕」加入韓式辣醬、泡菜、指天椒、蒜頭，豐富辣味層次。「韓式生牛肉飯」的精髓是平價和牛及一系列韓製醃料。還有炸雞配上自家醬料，加料大豆芽滾湯。

programme.title: 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 《用心‧家的中秋味道》由星級藝員傅嘉莉、關嘉敏、關楓馨、姚焯菲、黃奕斌、謝雪心參與演出。節目藉着一家四姐妹跟月餅相關的工作、學習與生活日常，帶出連鎖餅店用心製作、研發不同口味、款式的月餅，務求讓顧客能夠透過這種中秋慶節食品，感受家的味道。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 吃太飽會「谷氣」，是甚麼原因？呼吸系統科醫生提到與胃酸有關，但若然行路都「谷氣」，便需要做檢查找出成因，並採取針對性的處理方法，隨時是心肺功能或呼吸系統出問題？膏肓疼痛症的名稱源自背部的「膏肓穴」，或因頸椎問題、不當健身動作而引起？脊醫指患者不一定嚴重到「病入膏肓」，只要正面接受治療就可舒緩痛症，做伸展運動也甚重要。鄭紫欣的「招牌鵝膶腸法式威靈頓牛柳」曾獲謝霆鋒讚好，這次會於「睇餸食飯」公開食譜！

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵PG
programme.desc: 茂名盛產荔枝，團隊深入唐代貢園，一探百年荔枝樹；再到荔枝博覽館，醫肚兼長知識。品嚐荔枝甜食後漫步玻璃棧道，俯瞰美「荔」風光。古色古香的天然溫泉區，可邊浸溫泉邊看表演，四位女主持還換上漢服投入古風情懷。上山探尋世外桃源，在絕美竹海、雲海相伴下，泳裝上陣的煒哥Hea歎天台泳池，靚人靚景！另會一嚐傳統高涼菜特色。遊山過後要「玩水」，眾人擁抱電白海岸與浪漫沙灘，狂擦海鮮燒烤大餐，欣賞煙火綻放，玩得盡興！

programme.title: 東坡家事#17粵
programme.desc: 淑眉在街上遇到父母，藉口帶他們到客棧暫住。大妹因見紅擔心胎兒不保，大夫卻指她非小產而是信期，她與季常不知怎告訴月娥。史密跟蘇轍外出後，按樹葉上的小洞畫出地形。蘇轍開集思會被捉拿。東坡與琴操一見如故……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子弄得房間雜亂，結果引來蟑螂，嚇得她馬上叫爺爺幫手滅蟲。後來蟑螂再度出現，終於迫得媽媽出手，炮製據說可以毒死蟑螂的硼酸丸。小丸子回到學校，驚見中村帶了蟑螂回來，更觸發巨大恐慌。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 電子化的世代，加上忙碌的課後活動，小學生的閱讀時間似乎越來越少，如何提起他們的閱讀興趣？「Kids’ Notes」請來中文補習導師提供建議。導師指閱讀有助建立正向價值觀、培養語感和同理心等，建議小學生可從短篇故事集或科普類書籍開始，培養每日閱讀十五分鐘的習慣，並隨自身興趣增加時數。多閱讀中文書，也對寫作有幫助。導師列舉出高小生作文常見的三種錯誤，可如何糾正並做好？默寫課文、寫日記也可提升寫作能力？

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 細菌人襲擊焗盅麻呂，剛巧蒜頭小子路過，並誤打誤撞妨礙了細菌人作惡。小提琴人在湖畔演奏給大家聽，遇上細菌來搗亂。方包超人及時出現並擊退了細菌人。小提琴人為表謝意，決定為方包超人演奏一曲。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 日出康城一名業主，買入新盤示範單位，連同全屋家具及裝修，有甚麼要注意？交樓質素如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2866粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 敢威獨力支撐接龍，設法取得某集團的護眼素獨家代理權。敢威服用護眼素後喝酒，卻因此短暫失明，醫生診斷約一星期後視力才可恢復。身為護眼素代言人的敢威決定隱瞞病情，在住所休養。力王意外得知並向天娥等人洩露此事。龍家眾人遂偷偷齊集敢威住所，暗中輪流照顧他……其後，敢威成功取得該集團全線藥品的獨家代理，着虹豆沙湯遠將合約送交集團老闆簽署。力蓮等人意外發現合約上的交易銀碼疑似有誤，遂暗中設法幫敢威作出修正……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#3粵PG
programme.desc: 雪文欲親自到幸如家向幸如賠罪，幸如將計就計，相約繼威到家中，為二人提供單獨相處的機會，希望藉此令二人搭上。家謙因目擊幸如流露失落難過神色，因此想到珠寶廣告的主題。當家謙以為一切順利之際，廣告意念被另一公司捷足先登，更遭插贓嫁禍指控他出賣公司……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 青光眼被指是「視力小偷」，初期患者會看到兩邊的影像模糊，眼科教授同時強調，有些晚期青光眼病人也難發覺徵狀！個案主角晚上常躺着用平板看劇，教授指未有臨床證據證實此舉會引致青光眼；較大的風險因素是深近視，而做過激光矯視亦未能撇除高風險，為甚麼？定期做檢查及早診斷對預防青光眼極重要，有何檢查新技術？治療方面則以降低眼壓為主，小手術不超過廿分鐘就可完成？調查員秀怡另到訪中醫醫院，一探中藥師的職責。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#8粵普
programme.desc: 紀封不滿凱鑫的解決方式，要管理層找新的布草供應商，紀封訂的貨被扣在海關，凱鑫截下蜜語的提案，只有他的提案交予紀封，蜜語到紀封房間換上供應商雲海的樣品讓他查看，浦榮與雲海達成合作，蜜語獲獎金卻惹下屬不滿

programme.desc: 松蔭支持澤雨入股傲堂，報答啟堂當年相助之餘，伺機重振天蔭。高哲反對，與定垚再起爭執。小慧重遇昔日追求者陳俊才，心動想跟他到美國，只待觀察程凱的反應。啟堂回家休養，但對人事盡變心酸流淚。永成提議麗瞳入股，定垚欲拉攏麗瞳時被當眾掌摑，麗瞳事後還到處炫耀。永廉看出小慧喜歡程凱，獻計示愛，惜程凱刻意迴避。麗瞳被記者偷拍，明晞出手解決，兩人成好友。天生游說定垚踢高哲出董事局，高哲反警告定垚主席之位可能不保。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵PG
programme.desc: 茂名盛產荔枝，團隊深入唐代貢園，一探百年荔枝樹；再到荔枝博覽館，醫肚兼長知識。品嚐荔枝甜食後漫步玻璃棧道，俯瞰美「荔」風光。古色古香的天然溫泉區，可邊浸溫泉邊看表演，四位女主持還換上漢服投入古風情懷。上山探尋世外桃源，在絕美竹海、雲海相伴下，泳裝上陣的煒哥Hea歎天台泳池，靚人靚景！另會一嚐傳統高涼菜特色。遊山過後要「玩水」，眾人擁抱電白海岸與浪漫沙灘，狂擦海鮮燒烤大餐，欣賞煙火綻放，玩得盡興！

programme.title: 東坡家事#18粵
programme.desc: 少游因討得皇上歡心而升官。月娥使計成為一扇軒唯一老闆，大妹一無所有。月娥知道假懷孕後要季常休掉大妹，季常拒絕並與大妹離開陳府。皇上假扮書僮要東坡帶他見琴操。季常遭賊匪打劫，衣服被搶，被途人誤會行乞……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#156粵
programme.desc: 慈姑突向慶等挑戰乒乓球，可是慶竟發現球拍被人塗花，回藥房問罪。喜直認不諱，指為懲罰他「不務正業」。慶看到「一蚊雞代客整蠱」服務網站，竟訂了整套服務給喜。翌日慶發現喜遇上連場怪事，全應驗了「整蠱服務」。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 大漠上，江南七怪苦尋六年，終通過匕首找到郭靖，並收其為徒。郭靖資質愚鈍，經馬鈺傳授內功心法後，武功突飛猛進。郭靖獨自赴比武之約，巧遇乞丐裝扮的黃蓉。穆家父女比武招親，完顏康佔了便宜卻拒絕與穆念慈成親…

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 不少懷舊歌曲的經典旋律，在時間長廊中震盪前進，至今都隱現餘音，教人百聽不厭。鄭錦昌、麗莎、華娃、李龍基、姚兵五位實力唱將聚首今集節目，奉上<四季歌、<啼笑姻緣、<幾度夕陽紅等懷舊國、粵金曲。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#157粵
programme.desc: 悅遇上同學「油脂玲」志玲，身為警察的她在悅滿面前捉拿悍匪。玲捉賊之事被電視廣泛報導，但悅滿面不屑，更認為自己於求學時以風紀身份教育她，令她有此成就。悅感人生沒起伏，想起是因朋向她求婚才令她放棄考警察。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#2粵普PG
programme.desc: 郭靖看不慣完顏康欺負穆家父女，出手教訓，卻不是他對手，幸得王處一相助。王處一中了毒砂掌，所需藥材卻早已被人買光。郭靖與黃蓉河邊相見，看她一身女裝才知她身分。二人夜闖王府找藥材，發現穆家父女被關在牢中。

programme.title: 食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽教你用一種平價蔬菜取代薄荷葉，炮製豬膶蛋花湯，還透露令煲湯豬膶特別爽腍秘方。「大蝦炒鮮奶」煮法容易，處理金華火腿、蝦仁和鮮奶各有竅門。肥媽還教你用近百元的大墨魚，煮出過千元的花膠口感。

programme.title: 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 《用心‧家的中秋味道》由星級藝員傅嘉莉、關嘉敏、關楓馨、姚焯菲、黃奕斌、謝雪心參與演出。節目藉着一家四姐妹跟月餅相關的工作、學習與生活日常，帶出連鎖餅店用心製作、研發不同口味、款式的月餅，務求讓顧客能夠透過這種中秋慶節食品，感受家的味道。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵
programme.desc: 遊茂名必吃海鮮，「好玩隊」帶薛家燕逛魚市場，買馬鮫魚蛋做手信；「夠歎隊」則安排酒店級海鮮餐，黃椒醬蒸蟶子、「蠔炸」好惹味。好心湖呈藍、綠色，團隊踩單車遊湖畔，唱聚大草地兼野餐，皆大歡喜！街頭美食滿載風味，到牛雜一條街嚐牛心頂等少見部位，再往夜市試試臭豆腐、燒豬腦。下一站，「援兵」徐榮、阮浩棕入隊玩轉陽江。汽車服務區成網紅熱點，還可盡情買手信？享用傳統農家菜後輕鬆耍樂，酒店「游乾水」最合家燕姐心意。

programme.title: 東坡家事#18粵
programme.desc: 少游因討得皇上歡心而升官。月娥使計成為一扇軒唯一老闆，大妹一無所有。月娥知道假懷孕後要季常休掉大妹，季常拒絕並與大妹離開陳府。皇上假扮書僮要東坡帶他見琴操。季常遭賊匪打劫，衣服被搶，被途人誤會行乞……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子在雜誌上看見百貨公司懸紅尋找槌之子，正好小玉在學校說自己看到槌之子被質疑，兩人加上丸尾一起尋找槌之子，並計劃用獎金成立末玉桃槌之子股份有限公司，將來享受榮華富貴、窮奢極侈。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 藉着兔仔跳、弓箭步等動作充份熱身後，兒童體適能教練Ban Sir引領大家鍛練下肢的爆發力。除了做出原地跳、左右跳的動作外，還會安排兩人一組，利用阻力帶進行訓練，小朋友在家亦可邀請爸媽一同參與，增添互動樂趣。稍作休息後繼續「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，核心訓練需要利用氣球作輔助工具，重點是加強腰腹肌群力量，動作是怎樣的？另外，本集還會播放AI生成動畫《濫竽充數》的下半部。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 小源終於拍攝她第一道甜品烹飪片。正當大家享受茶會之際，烹飪偶像佐藤楓突然闖入攝影廠，把小源帶到外面。出於興趣相近，小楓對小源很有興趣，還說起她對愛麗絲比亞的感情。然而就在這時，多蘭再次現身。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 2003年，政府三十幾年來第一次實施隔離令，將淘大花園E座居民隔離，其後更宣布將所有E座居民全部搬去度假營，新聞掏寶和大家重溫2003年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐卓越理財呈獻:卓越滙談粵
programme.desc: 累積財富後如何令家庭及子女的未來更有保障？滙豐卓越理財《卓越滙談》聚焦四大主題，涵蓋財富管理、環球升學、家庭健康、旅遊及時尚品味禮遇，結合專業觀點，提供實用資訊讓觀眾更全面規劃未來。

programme.title: 東張西望粵 及 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2867粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 敢威因某海峽遭封鎖，蒙受極大損失。Ceci主動借錢助他解困，敢威以20%接龍股權作抵押。另一方面，力蓮等人決定不收分文放棄各自的接龍股權，與敢威互不相欠，雙方鬧得不歡而散。其後，眾人分別遇上麻煩，Ceci告知是敢威所為，她還出手幫助各人。Ceci認為敢威太過份，提出讓他改過之法，提議眾人將股份出讓給她，眾人察覺有詐而拒絕，詎料……接龍再次變天，力蓮想到替敢威取回一半話事權的方法，但必須作出犧牲……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#4粵PG
programme.desc: 珠寶廣告構思外洩，原來是家謙兄長葉啟榮的陰謀。幸如憶起夢裡家謙因此被迫辭職，繼威漁人得利因而升職；升職後的繼威隨即向幸如求婚，成為夢中不幸人生的起點。幸如設法協助家謙，不讓夢境成真，終與家謙一同構思出新的廣告主題。家謙成功化解危機，與幸如關係出現進展。熙妍推敲出幸如能「預知未來」，更為此質問她，幸如只好坦白「預知夢」一事。幸如與公司其他女生結為好友，被冷落的雪文心有不甘，決定出手將幸如搶回來……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 前列腺癌是本港男性第三大癌症殺手，且有年輕化趨勢。這集改編自真實案例的患者是職業貨車司機，他原以為腰痠背痛只是工作勞損，怎料求醫後確診前列腺癌第四期。泌尿外科教授吳志輝指出，多肉少菜、高脂飲食都可能是病因，也澄清忍尿、飲水不足並不會誘發前列腺癌。吳教授進一步介紹局部定位治療與前列腺癌的微創手術，都有助減少病人在手術過程中的創傷；調查科也會向中醫教授了解如何協助患者術後調理，以及日常飲食的注意事項。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#9粵普
programme.desc: 紀封著手查帳，財務部送去幾車亂帳，給他個下馬威。一直帶頭對抗蜜語的小佳被客人投訴偷竊，蜜語不計前嫌解決事件，保住了小佳，並藉此事恩威並施，贏得人心。本已辭職的薛睿不忍紀封孤軍作戰，決定重返浦榮支援他。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
再創世紀#17粵PG
programme.desc: 麗瞳動議撤換主席，天生率先支持，讓定垚看清其真面目。投票之際，啟堂突然出現。思妤收到太陽花以為是高哲所送，沒想到是追求者。定垚得知父親心臟病發真相，報警求助。程凱再次從小慧身上得到靈感，決定研發智能家居，成功獲得董事注資。令翹向明晞推銷自己，明晞要她查探學禮有何動作。明晞估計學禮想參與能源項目，天生決定插手分一杯羹。天生宣布出讓傲堂股份，啟堂私下詢問高哲會否跟自己爭奪。定垚驚悉內地發展部集體辭職…

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐對於農夫介紹何遠東、胡鴻鈞兩位嘉賓出場的笑話，搖頭大表失望，卻見農夫一臉「得戚」？原來在保加利亞，點頭與搖頭有相反意思！台灣「問題專員」欣賞店舖內的藝術畫，又大歎咖啡，究竟店內賣甚麼？泰國的超大型餐廳可容納五千位食客，連菜式亦大有名堂，一道「堅離地冬蔭公」因何得名？日本湯料販賣機供應的樽裝調味湯料，內裡又有甚麼特別？今集竟有嘉賓答題捧蛋收場，幸得Do姐大發慈悲送分，方可參與兌換貨幣遊戲……

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐請來麥美恩、周奕瑋上演精彩對壘。適當使用酒具能增添飲酒時的樂趣；韓國一款像手榴彈般的新奇產品，有何作用？兩位嘉賓信心十足，同時利用雙倍錦囊先拔頭籌，更得Do姐大讚叻叻！法國里昂大街突兀地出現一格紅色地磚？美國亞利桑那一間洞穴酒店，竟建議住客「朝十晚四」離開房間，如不遵從會發生甚麼事？看過貼士的C君試圖用謊話擾亂敵隊，卻被陸永一眼看穿……今集兌換貨幣環節又刷新紀錄！

programme.title: 王國戰隊
programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼群守護者路卡、熊群保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾群守護者提傑，以及貓群守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.desc: 全新場景、全新比賽陣容、全新遊戲並結合世界各國的場景與關卡。考驗麻吉好友和團體的合作默契，一場場歡笑、緊張與刺激的團體競賽，陪伴大朋友小朋友週末的歡聚時光。

programme.title: 我們，家
programme.desc: 【金喜善陷入家庭危機！神秘女子揭露家族秘密】心理學博士兼知名人物英媛與家人過著幸福生活，直到神秘女子世娜的出現引發連鎖事件。公公意外身亡，丈夫在振與世娜失蹤，揭露他們的不倫關係。在尋找丈夫的過程中，英媛發現世娜是心理變態，曾殺死三個前夫。同時，兒子道賢也坦承與學校前輩素伊有了孩子。家庭的秘密逐漸浮出水面，英媛必須面對現實，守護家人並解開所有的謎團。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 珠玉在側(完)
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 王國戰隊

programme.title: 我們，家(完)
programme.desc: 【金喜善陷入家庭危機！神秘女子揭露家族秘密】心理學博士兼知名人物英媛與家人過著幸福生活，直到神秘女子世娜的出現引發連鎖事件。公公意外身亡，丈夫在振與世娜失蹤，揭露他們的不倫關係。在尋找丈夫的過程中，英媛發現世娜是心理變態，曾殺死三個前夫。同時，兒子道賢也坦承與學校前輩素伊有了孩子。家庭的秘密逐漸浮出水面，英媛必須面對現實，守護家人並解開所有的謎團。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Amber the Ambulance takes Katy to the hospital
programme.desc: Katy needs help; she's feeling sick! Troy selects the most helpful, kindest car he knows: Amber the Ambulance!

programme.desc: Oh no, there's bales of hay all over the highway! Troy selects the most helpful truck he knows: Ben the Tractor!

programme.desc: Suzy had an accident and needs urgent help! Troy selects the most perfect vehicle to help rescue her: Hector the Helicopter!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Sam the Snowplough clears the streets
programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El desierto

Pero ahora, el Dr. No ha desviado el flujo de amoníaco para su propio beneficio. Chip descubre el punto donde se desvía el amoníaco y construye una presa que lo devuelve a su curso normal.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S02 - It's Time to Remember Grandad
programme.desc: JoJo wants to know more about Grandad, so Gran Gran takes her on an adventure to remember Grandad, by doing all his favourite winter activities.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Feelings Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels notice that Happy looks and seems different - he is frowning, his smile is upside down, and he's wearing new trainers! When they check in on him, Happy is frustrated, but he can't seem to identify where his frustration is coming from. They turn to Duggee for help, who uses his feeling cards to explain an array of feelings to Happy. All the Squirrels help by relaying their past experiences and the feelings that they evoked.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Days of the Week Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to learn that Mr Wobbly, the jelly juggler, is coming to town, and they can't wait to see him. But they become impatient, so Duggee makes sure to explain to them that the week will fly by and there's a lot to be done in that time. Duggee explains that a week is made up of seven days and what activities he does each day to stay busy. Each squirrel excitedly shares their usual plans between Monday and Friday so that they have something to look forward to while they wait f

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Let’s play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Mount Rushmore, USA
programme.desc: The Go Jetters have gone to Mount Rushmore, to see the carvings of the President's faces in the mountainside, but there's a less presidential face adorning the monument - and it has a moustache! The Go Jetters launch the Vroomster to investigate and soon realize that Glitch's face isn't carved into the mountainside at all, but moulded from mud - this is going to be easy to fix, right?

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Fig
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the nicest, kindest, Fig, performing his song, "Just Can't Help Being Sweet!"

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Apple
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Apple. Singing in celebration of her great-great-grandad, Apple Tree's, 100th birthday.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Da Veggie Code
programme.desc: Supertato's Tato belt gets locked inside a glass case for an exhibition, but Tomato can't remember the code to get it out again, and Supertato needs it back to defeat Evil Pea.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Double Trouble
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are looking for ice and think Evil Pea has become kind by giving them some. They soon realise it's not Evil Pea after all.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Songtime
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dispy, Laa-Laa and Po enjoy Tiddlytubbies Songtime. Then it is time for Teletubbies Songtime. The Teletubbies sing solo before singing all together.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, & colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the “Full Moon Scimitar”, on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the “speed gang”, led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the “speed gang” while on the island – can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the “speed gang”, led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the “speed gang” while on the island – can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father…

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of "Money, Sex And Love", this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from “Nine Yang Scriptures” by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancée, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the “Tsai Li Fu” style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom. Later, Ying discovers that she is pregnant but no one can remember

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.desc: Jim must go to trial for releasing Gunmar from the Darklands

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - In The Hall Of The Gumm-Gumm King
programme.desc: When Gunmar marches for Heartsone Trollmarket, the Trollhunting team must save the remaining Trolls and face Gunmar before all is lost

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Truth Be Told
programme.desc: During her last days on Earth, Aja decides to tell Steve the truth: she's an alien. But her plans are complicated when the Zerons abduct Aja, Steve and Krel. Meanwhile, Vex struggles with an impossible choice: saving the Royal teens or the Royal Cores.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Last Night on Earth
programme.desc: With the Mothership ready for liftoff, Aja and Krel celebrate their last day on Earth at Battle of the Bands. But their world is rocked when Zadra arrives with a startling revelation about Vex – and a new enemy threatens their departure.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Bad Omen
programme.desc: When Omen hijacks the Mothership and Royal Cores, all seems lost for our heroes. The Royal heirs are able to defeat the killer Blank, but at a high cost.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Witch Hunt
programme.desc: With the future at stake, Douxie and Claire cling to the hope that Arthur and Morgana can reconcile. Meanwhile, humans are hunting trolls in the woods.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Lady of the Lake
programme.desc: Merlin leads his ragtag crew on a quest to restore Excalibur and save Camelot. Elsewhere, Jim tries to convince Blinky that they're on the same side.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - The Gray Matter Fever Break
programme.desc: Oh and Tip discover an underground cult living in the sewers.While Tip is home with a fever, she witnesses a crime committed by her scheming neighbor, Donny.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Wrinkly Humans People Piggy Piggy
programme.desc: Tip doesn't think her grandparents will approve of Oh so he disguises himself as a humans housekeeperSharzod adopts Pig and names him “Juicy Booty.”

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Dino-Can-Do Big Bad Bug
programme.desc: Crackridge's new resident dinosaur has a hard time fitting in. Archibald and a new friend attempt to conquer their fear of the basement.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Stuck in Skates Lawn Circles
programme.desc: After ice skating with his pen pal, Archibald can't remove his too-tight skates. Crackridge has crop circles. Could aliens really be responsible?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And Grandma's Visit
programme.desc: Grandma is coming to visit, and Olivia couldn't be more excited. She's less excited, however, about having to give up her bedroom and bunk with Ian. But when Grandma invites Olivia to share her room for a sleepover, Olivia finds out that rooming with her snoring grandmother isn't as much fun as she thought!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Is Invited To Dinner
programme.desc: Olivia is thrilled to be invited to Francine's for dinner, until she learns that she must reciprocate with an invitation. She worries that Francine will be unimpressed by her family's casual table manners. But after dinner at Francine's proves not to be much fun, Olivia appreciates her own lively family dinners.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Measures Up
programme.desc: After Olivia teases Ian for being too short for a ride, Father mentions that someday Ian may be the taller sibling. Olivia employs a variety of comical methods to stop Ian from growing. She eventually comes to terms with her own height – with the help of a great pair of shoes!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And The Old West
programme.desc: The class bullfrog is lose, and Mrs. Hogenmuller leaves Olivia in charge as she goes to track it down. Olivia imagines herself as the sheriff of a Wild West town, keeping order and defending against a stampede of giant bullfrogs. But can shedo it alone, or will she need a little help – from Francine?

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Yarn Fairy Bake It ‘Til You Make It
programme.desc: When the trees start losing their leaves, Phoebe begins knitting the trees in the park sweaters, but when the neighborhood kids see the sweaters they think they're a mysterious "Yarn Fairy," and they want to see her in action, making it much harder for the Dews to put more sweaters on the latest trees that have lost their leaves. When Marcus and Harper team-up for a school project, they decide to bake something ("It's like inventing, but with food!"), only to come across multiple baking missha

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Things That Go Bump Hide Like a Dew Drop
programme.desc: When "something" starts snatching things and causing havoc in Marcus' house, Phoebe and the Dew Drops investigate only to find that it's a stray kitten that they need to catch and find a home for before Marcus returns home. But in the end, Marcus decides to take the kitty in, as his own. Lola isn't very good at “Hide & Seek” so the Dew Drops help her improve her game. But she becomes so good that no one can find her! And now she’s going to be late to her own surprise tea party!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Store Day
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a coin purse with kitty coins, it's Store Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy help out at all the different stores (Cakey's Bakery, Baby Box's Craft Emporium, Kitty Fairy's Flower Shoppe) to earn kitty coins and save up for a melodicat at the Grand Opening of DJ Catnip’s Music Store!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy's Sleepover
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy and the Gabby Cats prepare for a sleepover in the Garden, they discover Pillow Cat has never been to a sleepover. They help her conquer her fears and enjoy her first sleepover.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Gloriasaurus
programme.desc: The gang heads to the Museum of Dinosaurs. But Gloria becomes obsessed with her handheld video game and misses out on what's in front of her, and ends up creating a disaster of colossal proportions.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - A Fang-Tastic Halloween
programme.desc: After hearing spooky rumors about the new habitat resident- A BAT- Marty is determined to protect his friends from the newcomer. But when the bat helps him out of a tough situation, Marty learns it’s better to get to know someone rather than judge them on false stereotypes.
